holdings.name: TVS Motor Company Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 sales rose 24% to 672,790 units, taking Q2 sales growth to 27%.
The company entered into an agreement to lease 5.3 lakh sq ft of office space in Bengaluru for an annual rent of ₹56 crore.
TVS Motor launched a refreshed Radeon motorcycle with LED lighting and new graphics.

holdings.why_it_matters: TVS Motor is the portfolio's top holding at 9.51% weight and was its largest 3-month positive contributor (+1.282%), countering broader declines across the fund's 35.3% consumer discretionary allocation.

watch.text: Board meeting on 28 October 2026 to approve Q2 FY2027 standalone and consolidated results.
Progress on the planned 2027 launch of an electric mini-truck developed with Hyundai to rival Tata Ace.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Approved Q2 FY2027 results on 17 October 2026, delivering standalone net profit of ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of ₹16,333 crore.
CASA ratio dropped 340 bps to 36.1% alongside a surge in foreign currency non-resident deposits.
Shares declined 1% following earnings despite brokerage target price increases.

holdings.why_it_matters: As the fund's second-largest asset at 6.90% weight, ICICI Bank's 3-month decline of -5.42% cost the fund -0.374% in performance, leading weakness in its 21.2% financials basket.

watch.text: CASA deposit stabilization and funding cost management following the ratio drop to 36.1%.

holdings.name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd

what_changed.text: Income Tax Appellate Tribunal granted approximately ₹13,000 crore in tax relief covering FY14 to FY20 and FY22.
Company held Alto and S-Presso entry-level car prices unchanged despite rising manufacturing costs.
Order booking backlog surpassed 2 lakh vehicles ahead of the festive season.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.48% position, Maruti fell -15.09% over 3 months, creating a -0.676% contribution drag and acting as the second-largest detractor in the fund.

watch.text: Q2 FY2026 unaudited financial results consideration scheduled for the 27 October 2026 board meeting.
Production ramp-up and order execution on the 2 lakh vehicle festive backlog.

holdings.name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY2027 consolidated net profit rose 7.6% to ₹742.98 crore while revenue rose 18.4% to ₹19,206 crore, adding 15 new stores.
The stock touched a 52-week low as analysts highlighted a growth mismatch between revenue and earnings.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.18% fund weight, Avenue Supermarts was the single biggest detractor over 3 months, peeling off -0.706% from the fund as the stock fell -16.89%.

watch.text: Store addition pace and store-level operating leverage after adding 15 stores in Q2.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Flipkart initiated plans to enter food delivery with 'Eat-in by Minutes' to compete against Zomato and Swiggy.
Food safety authorities initiated FIRs against officials of Blinkit and Zomato Hyperpure over expired food products.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 3.73%, Zomato generated a 11.59% 3-month return, delivering a +0.432% contribution that supported the portfolio's 11.1% technology exposure.

watch.text: Board approval and earnings call on 21 October 2026 for Q2 and half-year FY2026 results.
Developments from the food safety enforcement actions involving Blinkit and Hyperpure warehouses.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Equity stake in NDET dropped from 72.07% to 49.63%, removing it as a step-down subsidiary.
Management stated electric vehicle sales could increase by 2,000 to 3,000 units monthly once supply constraints clear.
Launched the XUV 3XO CNG variant at a starting price of ₹9.99 lakh.

holdings.why_it_matters: M&M carries a 3.46% weight and delivered an -8.17% return over 3 months, contributing -0.283% to fund losses alongside other passenger vehicle holdings.

watch.text: Supply chain easing to realize the incremental 2,000–3,000 monthly EV sales potential.
Volume trends following Tata Motors overtaking M&M as the No. 2 carmaker in H1.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Approved Q2 FY2027 standalone and consolidated results on 17 October 2026 with net profit reaching ₹21,537 crore.
Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha announced plans to step down on 31 December 2026.
Share price dropped 2% post-earnings as brokerages cited pressure on margins.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank represents 3.12% of the fund and fell -8.44% over 3 months, compounding returns pressure across the fund's 21.2% financial sector exposure.

watch.text: Upcoming leadership succession as Deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha departs on 31 December 2026.
Net interest margin trajectory following broker price target adjustments.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported Q2 FY2027 standalone net profit up 38% year-on-year to ₹7,003 crore.
Appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking starting 19 October 2026.
Stock slid 4% on 19 October 2026 after quarterly profit missed analyst estimates.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank holds a 3.08% weight; its -1.59% 3-month return kept financials performance subdued within the fund.

watch.text: Delivery on the raised FY2027 loan growth estimate of 20%.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Rolled out voice-only prepaid tariff plans starting at ₹185 pursuant to a TRAI mandate.
Launched IQ Gateway, a DPDP-compliant enterprise platform covering WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, and voice.
Department of Telecommunications levied subscriber verification penalties totaling ₹1.5 lakh, ₹7.36 lakh, and ₹1.27 lakh across October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel accounts for 2.42% of the fund, logging a -3.35% return over 3 months within the 11.1% technology allocation.

watch.text: ARPU effects following the launch of TRAI-mandated voice-only plans starting at ₹185.
Valuation shifts and market positioning ahead of Reliance Jio's ₹30,213 crore IPO.

holdings.name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd.

what_changed.text: Institutional block deals worth roughly ₹1,895 to ₹1,985 crore were executed, with Alpha Wave and SoftBank selling stakes to domestic and foreign funds.
Customs authorities issued an order demanding ₹13.17 crore in duty and penalty on imported optical eyeframes.

holdings.why_it_matters: Lenskart forms 2.36% of the portfolio and generated an 18.14% 3-month return, contributing +0.428% as the fourth-highest positive driver in the fund.

watch.text: Board meeting on 4 November 2026 to review Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 unaudited results.
Resolution of the ₹13.17 crore customs duty and penalty demand.

portfolio.statement: The portfolio carries 35.3% in Consumer Discretionary and 21.2% in Financials, where sharp gains in two-wheelers and digital platforms were outweighed by broad pullbacks in passenger autos, retail, and major banks.
interp: Heavy weighting in TVS Motor (+13.48%) and new-age tech like Zomato (+11.59%) insulated the fund from steeper category drawdowns.
Simultaneous negative returns across Avenue Supermarts, Maruti Suzuki, M&M, and ICICI Bank drove the fund's 3-month return to -1.24%.
portfolio.line: Divergence between two-wheelers and passenger vehicles, paired with banking margin compression, drove 3-month performance.

drivers.text: TVS Motor lifted fund performance by contributing +1.282% on the back of 27% Q2 volume growth.
Avenue Supermarts detracted -0.706% as Q2 profit growth slowed to 7.6% against 18.4% revenue expansion.
Maruti Suzuki cost the fund -0.676% in contribution as shares dropped 15.09% despite carrying a 2 lakh vehicle backlog.
Axis Bank and ICICI Bank fell following Q2 results amid margin pressures and a 340 bps drop in ICICI's CASA ratio.

themes.title: Two-Wheeler Momentum vs Four-Wheeler Lull
themes.text: TVS Motor saw volume growth of 27% in Q2, while Maruti Suzuki and Mahindra & Mahindra struggled with cost inflation and component shortages.

themes.title: Modern Retail Compression vs Platform Scale
themes.text: Avenue Supermarts faced margin friction and earnings-revenue mismatch, whereas digital platform Zomato expanded revenue alongside Blinkit growth.

themes.title: Private Banking Margin Adjustment
themes.text: ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, and Axis Bank all experienced post-earnings share price declines as lenders navigated CASA mix changes and net interest margin compression.

macro.factor: Automotive Supply Constraints and Order Backlogs
macro.why: Component bottlenecks constrain monthly EV sales by up to 3,000 units at M&M, while Maruti works through a 200,000-unit festive order book.

macro.factor: Deposit Composition and Cost of Funds
macro.why: A 340 bps drop in CASA ratio at ICICI Bank and broker concerns over HDFC Bank margins highlight system-wide deposit repricing pressure.

priced_in.text: Strong volume expansion of 24% in September 2026 is reflected in TVS Motor's share price run-up.
Avenue Supermarts' margin compression and revenue-profit growth disconnect are absorbed in its 52-week low valuation.

could_change.title: Passenger Vehicle Supply Normalization
could_change.text: If Mahindra & Mahindra resolves EV component supply issues to add 2,000 to 3,000 monthly units and Maruti converts its 2 lakh backlog, passenger auto contributions may recover.

could_change.title: New Competitors in Food Delivery
could_change.text: Flipkart's entry into rapid food delivery via 'Eat-in by Minutes' could alter market share dynamics and take rates for incumbent platforms like Zomato.

portfolio.risk_note: A combined 56.5% portfolio allocation across Consumer Discretionary (35.3%) and Financials (21.2%) concentrates fund outcomes in domestic festive consumption trends and banking net interest margin cycles.
